connector.name: Shopify MCP Pro
connector.registryDescription: Shopify MCP server with real analytics (ShopifyQL), auto-refresh auth, and Shopify API 2026-04.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package shopify-mcp-pro. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the den-indance account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
